prompts.ledge: From the provided original game concept reference, create ONE isolated reusable side-view terrain ledge asset for a 2D game, transparent background. Faithfully preserve its hand-painted look, soft dusty rose tongue tissue top, pale porous organic underface with small rounded holes and sparse olive dangling filaments. NOT fleshy red steak, NOT carved wood roots, NOT photorealistic. A single horizontal gently undulating but almost flat walkable top across 90% width with rounded end caps. Broad upper shelf, tapering irregular organic underside, about 4:1 width:height. No floor below, no characters, no lamps, no doors, no reward, no text, no glow border. Painted warm ivory rim light and blue shadow. Asset fills most canvas with 5% transparent padding. Match the reference's delicate brushwork. The goal is a modular terrain asset which can be stretched along exact collision coordinate surfaces.
prompts.oral-depth: Extract and repaint ONLY the far background from the supplied whale mouth game concept reference, as a complete wide 2D game background texture. Remove all characters, enemies, foreground framing, platforms, gates, ropes, lamps and rewards. Remove the close large bright hanging baleen canopy (that will be a separate layer). Leave only very distant blue organic palatal tissue ridges, submerged haze, subtle distant hanging bands and enormous curved tissue masses. No ribs or architecture. Dark deep cobalt/cyan, softly painted low contrast, strongly distant, NO bright apparent walkable platforms. Fill every edge with background, 16:9 wide. No alpha. Maintain original illustration style.
prompts.baleen: Extract and repaint the hanging baleen canopy of the reference as ONE separate transparent middle-distance layer asset for the original 2D game. Wide horizontal strip of muted mauve palatal root along the very top, long dense ivory fibers growing ONLY downward from its underside. Three irregular clumps, middle longest, ends shorter. Cool shadow, pale warm tips. The root should be fixed and not shaped like a jaw silhouette, no teeth, no horns. Delicate handpainted illustration, matching reference, not photorealistic. Nothing else: no fish, no platforms, no characters, no floor, no lamps, no text. Actual transparent background. Asset spans full width with a small transparent margin, top root thin, bottom tips uneven.
prompts.frame: Create ONE isolated transparent foreground lower-edge framing strip based on the reference's very dark closest organic edges. A low wide irregular ridge of deep navy porous abandoned shells, tiny tube colonies and organic folds. All objects connected along the bottom border, gently rising at left and right, extremely low silhouette in center. No tall central objects; no character, no lamps, no doors, no text, no whale baleen. Muted soft painted details, dark blue barely lighter than black, original hand-painted 2D underwater style. Transparent everything above this lower border. Wide 3:1 canvas, ridge mostly within lower half; completely free upper half.
prompts.foundation: Create a single transparent 2D game terrain FOUNDATION asset matching the supplied original concept. Asset is a broad organic tongue-tissue buttress, pale porous ivory understructure and dusty rose fleshy ridges, with a flat broad pink ledge across the top. Left and right ends of top curl naturally down into tapering irregular side walls. The lower tissue forks and thickens again at the bottom where it joins the unseen whale organ. Tall approximately square side-view silhouette; broad enough to support a large ledge, not a tiny hanging island. Brushy hand-painted like reference, blue shadow, small rounded marine sponge pores and restrained olive vines. Avoid carved tree roots, dark red steak, geometric triangle/trapezoid shape, hard straight side cuts, detached slices, columns of human architecture. No characters, doors, lamps, text. Transparent around shape. Solid painted material continues to the bottom canvas edge, so the lower edge can extend below viewport. This is one isolated editable modular foundation, not a full scene.
